svg.title: Cash capital spending against cash from operations, 2019 to 2026
svg.desc: Six small bar charts of annual capital spending and operating cash flow for Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle and CoreWeave. Spending rises sharply in all six. Capital spending stays below operating cash flow for Microsoft, Alphabet and Meta, nearly equals it for Amazon in 2025, and exceeds it for Oracle in fiscal 2025 and 2026 and for CoreWeave in every year.
svg.text: Cash capital spending against cash from operations, 2019 to 2026
Annual, USD billions, from SEC XBRL filings. Ratio above 1 means spending exceeded operating cash flow that year.
Payments to acquire property and equipment
Excludes finance leases and off-balance-sheet leases.
